text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2026.03.20 -> prod (change window 03:00-04:00 UTC). Smoke checks on, observability noise gate = 15m :hourglass: 

maya: watching p95 & 5xx on model-serving-1. Set alert thresholds: p95 > 150ms or 5xx rate > 2% for escalation.

sam: dashboard: https://observability.redwood/internal/dashboards/rollout-2026-03-20 (live tail) :link:

eli: seeing a short 429 spike in eu-west-1 at +7m into canary. small burst, looks like batching overflow.

maya: can you paste logs? also which canary group?

eli: group=canary-2. logs: `2026-03-20T03:07:12Z model-serving-1 429 batch_queue_overflow size=512`

sam: tagging @oncall-bot, creating an incident if it persists.

oncall-bot: incident INC-20260320-01 created (impact: transient 429s in eu-west-1). Pager: off by default for noise gate.

carla: quick question — rollback policy we landed on last week was: immediate pause on >5% error burst OR sustained breach (10m) of p95 SLA. confirm?

maya: yes, operationally we use: (1) single 5xx/429 burst >5% in a 1m window -> pause and triage, (2) sustained p95 >200ms for 10m -> rollback.

sam: I'm going to temporarily widen the noise-gate for p95 alert to 10m for this rollout only, to avoid flapping from short queues.

eli: paused traffic to canary-2 at +9m to drain backlog. attaching quick command for others: `infractl rollback --target canary-2 --drain 30s`

maya: after pause/pod-drain, p95 dropped from 180ms -> 95ms and 429s stopped. 5xx stayed <0.5%.

carla: if metrics stabilise for 15m, proceed with remainder of rollout. otherwise roll back to pinned version.

maya: recommendation: continue but pin model variant for canary-2 to `v1.4-quantized` to avoid batching behavior change. Add to release notes.

sam: updated release notes draft in #release-notes: "Pin canary-2 to v1.4-quantized after transient batching overflow; observability: raised noise-gate to 10m"

eli: re-enabled canary-2 traffic at +28m; monitoring shows stable. no further 429s.

oncall-bot: INC-20260320-01 auto-resolved (no incidents for 20m).

maya: final check at 03:45 UTC: p95=92ms, 5xx=0.12%, latency budget healthy. proceeding to full rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed 04:00 UTC. Notes: pinned canary-2 -> v1.4-quantized, noise-gate adjusted for this window.

carla: nice callout on the noise gate, saved a rollback. I'll add a short blurb to the post-rollout notes and mark this as "observability playbook update candidate".

sam: adding follow-up PR to telemetry to emit `batch_queue_length` in the canary metrics so we can alert earlier.

maya: thanks everyone. closing thread unless anyone needs more follow-up. :white_check_mark:
